name: profile-dropdown
title: Profile Dropdown
description: A compact account chip that grows into a tall menu: the avatar, name and email slide up into a header, and rows for status, theme, profile links, account switching and a hold-to-confirm sign-out appear below.
use: An app header needs one account control for theme, status, account switching, settings and sign-out.
avoid: The panel is a fixed 288px wide, so a cramped mobile header leaves it short of room to sit.
a11y: Roving arrow-key menu with role and aria-checked radios. Sign out needs a press-and-hold, which also works from the keyboard. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: Closed, a small dark rounded pill holds an initials avatar with a green dot, a name and email, and a chevron. Open, it becomes a tall dark rounded panel: stacked avatar and identity with a plan label on top, Status and Theme rows of small dots and icons, three menu rows, Switch account, and a Sign out row marked Hold.
behaves: Clicking the chip grows it into the menu while the avatar, name and email travel into the panel header. Status and theme choices update in place, Switch account slides sideways to a second page, and Sign out fires only after a press and hold; releasing early flips the row back with a Keep holding nudge.
customise: Pass accounts, menu items, status, theme and hold duration as props, with callbacks for each change. The panel width, spring and row styling live in the source.
weight: light: A handful of DOM rows and two spring-driven clip values; idle when closed.
